dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregularly shaped, light-colored closed and semi-closed loops with jagged perimeter geometries. Notable sharp gradient transitions from dark exterior fur to high-intensity light interior pixels are visible along the mid-body.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of punctate, high-intensity light clusters distributed primarily on the upper dorsal surface and interspersed between the larger ring structures. These clusters exhibit high core pixel concentration with minimal internal gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A prominent closed elliptical annulus in the center forms an obtuse triangle when connected to a smaller semi-closed loop located dorsally and a high-intensity blob cluster positioned anteriorly.
